# Check if current arrow raises errors on imaginary dates during shift
import arrow

# Try shifting across DST spring forward boundary
try:
    arw = arrow.get(2023, 3, 12, tzinfo="US/Eastern")
    result = arw.shift(hours=1)
    print(f"Shifted 1 hour from {arw}: {result}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")

# Try shifting to a time in the DST gap
try:
    arw = arrow.get(2023, 3, 12, 1, 30, tzinfo="US/Eastern")
    result = arw.shift(hours=1)
    print(f"Shifted 1 hour from {arw}: {result}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
